correctness.rationale: All n>=3: Kirchhoff trace identity yields a strictly convex sum of edge reciprocal costs; explicit two-parity candidate is feasible. Alternating partial-sum rational multipliers satisfy KKT stationarity and complementary slackness, and the four factorized numerator identities give strict positivity at every interior vertex. A Bregman identity with these multipliers establishes the exact nonnegative global excess and uniqueness. The proof does not infer infinite cases from 126807 finite/symbolic verifier assertions; the general polynomial factors are derived analytically.

value.rationale: A natural constrained Markov design optimization receives an explicit all-order complete answer and an exact performance-gap certificate, rather than another generic SDP restatement. The parity-sensitive conflict between spectral worst-mode mixing and mean stationary-target time is structural and rigorously quantified. The gain at even n is small at large n and no practical magnitude is exaggerated.
